# Sample uniformly and independently from d_k simplices

Sample uniformly and independently from d_k simplices

## Usage

``` r
runif_dk_vects(d_k, nsamp)
```

## Arguments

- d_k:

  vector of vector lengths

- nsamp:

  number of samples to take

## Value

A matrix with sum(d_k) columns and nsamp rows

## Examples
